body.name: Aligned population factorization input \(\mathcal R\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal R=[\{A^{(k)}\}_{k\in K},\{\mathcal L(\varepsilon^{(k)})\}_{k\in K}]_{\mathfrak M_q}\), where columns and independent non-Gaussian source laws are aligned across contexts. For \(M\in\mathfrak M_q\), the equivalence action is \(A^{(k)}\mapsto A^{(k)}M\) and \(\mathcal L(\varepsilon^{(k)})\mapsto\mathcal L(M^{-1}\varepsilon^{(k)})\) simultaneously for every \(k\in K\). Computation uses a rational projective gauge: after enumerating the common permutations compatible with the displayed topological order, scale each nonzero loading column so its least-index nonzero observed coordinate equals \(1\). Certificates are transported back over the simultaneous permutation orbit. This factorization datum is an explicit population input; its recovery from raw laws is not assumed inside the graph-compatibility map.
